params.name: discussionID
params.description: Filter by a range or CSV of discussion IDs.

params.name: categoryID
params.description: Filter by a category.

params.name: dateInserted
params.description: Filter by insert date. See [date filters](https://docs.vanillaforums.com/help/apiv2/date-filters/).

params.name: dateUpdated
params.description: Filter by update date. See [date filters](https://docs.vanillaforums.com/help/apiv2/date-filters/).

params.name: dateLastComment
params.description: Filter by the date of the last comment or the original discussion date if it has no comments. See [date filters](https://docs.vanillaforums.com/help/apiv2/date-filters/).

params.name: slotType
params.description: Filter to discussions created within a certain timeframe. Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, or all time.

params.name: siteSectionID
params.description:
Filter discussions by site section ID (ex. subcommunity).
The subcommunity ID or folder can be used if you use [smart IDs](https://success.vanillaforums.com/kb/articles/46-smart-ids).
The query looks like:

```
siteSectionID=$subcommunityID:{id|folder}
```

params.name: tagID
params.description: Filter discussion by a range of tag IDs.

params.name: tagOperator
params.description: Either 'and' or 'or'. 'or' logic means a post only needs 1 of the provided tags. 'and' means it needs all of them.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by discussion type, or comma separated list.

params.name: postTypeID
params.description: Filter by one or more postTypeIDs.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter questions by status (accepted, answered, unanswered).

params.name: excludeHiddenCategories
params.description: Exclude discussions from categories that has the `HideAllDiscussions` option set to true.

params.name: followed
params.description: Only fetch discussions from followed categories. Pinned discussions are mixed in.

params.name: userFollowed
params.description: Only fetch discussions from users the current user is following. Requires authentication. Returns empty array for guest users or users who follow no one.

params.name: score
params.description: Filter by score.

params.name: pinned
params.description: Whether or not to include pinned discussions. If true, only return pinned discussions. Cannot be used with the pinOrder parameter.

params.name: pinOrder
params.description:
If including pinned posts, in what order should they be integrated? When "first", discussions pinned to a specific category will only be affected if the discussion's category is passed as the categoryID parameter. Cannot be used with the pinned parameter.
Must be one of: "first", "mixed".

params.name: hasComments
params.description: Optionally only include discussions that have/doesn't have comments.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number. See [Pagination](https://docs.vanillaforums.com/apiv2/#pagination).

params.name: limit
params.description: Desired number of items per page. **Note that you may not get the exact number of records back as specified with the limit unless you also specify pinOrder=mixed**. This is an optimization for pinned (i.e. announcement) discussion handling.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort the results.

params.name: insertUserID
params.description: Filter by author.

params.name: insertUserRoleID
params.description: Filter by author role. One or more roleIDs can be passed in a CSV.

params.name: insertUserRankID
params.description: Filter by author rank. One or more rankIDs can be passed in a CSV.

params.name: expand
params.description: Expand associated records using one or more valid field names. A value of "all" will expand all expandable fields.

params.name: resolved
params.description: Filter by resolved status.

params.name: bookmarkUserID
params.description: Bookmarked by the UserID.

params.name: participatedUserID
params.description: Commented (participated) on by the UserID.

params.name: reactionType
params.description: Discussions for which the user has given the specified reaction.

params.name: statusID
params.description: List of statusIDs to filter discussion by.

params.name: internalStatusID
params.description: List of internalStatusIDs to filter discussion by.

params.name: suggested
params.description: Filter discussion list based on user interests.

params.name: excerptLength
params.description: Length of excerpts.

params.name: excludedCategoryIDs
params.description: Category IDs to exclude.
